boundary: Separate parent evaluator and directory after editor stopped. Same Unix user; no hard OS sandbox.
control_scope: One random column control per attempt, matched layer/count/factor, approximately similar intervention norm, not exact norm matching.
statistics: Exact McNemar values are exploratory conditional discordance tests. Synthetic paired cases share templates; they do not establish population failure rates.

public_replay.final_statistics: Aggregate and paired statistics from anonymized graded outcome rows
public_replay.not_available: Independent semantic rescoring of private final inputs/outputs
